Dota 2's Behavior and Communication System Needs a Serious Rework
16 Oct @ 11:48pm
Hiroshi
;565922740068981710]
Originally posted by Hiroshi:
You're making a lot of assumptions about how the system works, though. Do you have a source for the part about AI comparing chat, KDA and reports to decide who gets punished? Because unless we know exactly how it works, we're both guessing about some of the mechanics.


My point is that even if most people at that score deserve it, you can't automatically conclude that every single one does. You're treating the score as proof that the system is right, then using the system's punishment as proof that the score is right. That's circular reasoning.

And I agree that Valve can't manually investigate every report.
17 Oct @ 6:57am
Hiroshi
Originally posted by SG:
The real problem is reports shouldn't mean anything without verification.
I just had a game with a Tiny who was pos 5 and sitting and farming the jungle for 40 mins.
And if you react badly after being trolled for 40 minutes, you might end up getting reported yourself.

I'm not saying your reaction was necessarily the right one, but the system should be able to distinguish between someone deliberately ruining a game and someone reacting to a teammate who's doing it.
